title: glib: unsoundness in VariantStrIter iterator impls
evidence: glib 0.18.5 (Linux only, via Tauri's GTK3/webkit2gtk stack); fixed in glib 0.20
fix: Blocked upstream: Tauri 2 pins gtk-rs 0.18. Consilium doesn't use VariantStrIter. Re-check when Tauri moves to GTK4/gtk-rs 0.20+.

title: Fixed CLI turn deadline interrupts ongoing tool work
evidence: A Claude turn reached the 900-second absolute deadline despite producing a tool result about three minutes before expiry; the generic timeout discarded the activity context.
fix: PR #322 uses a 900-second inactivity budget renewed only by recognized provider activity, retains a 3600-second cap per CLI invocation and Stop cleanup, and reports the last activity. Four policy tests and six native fixtures cover the runner; an independent saturated-output harness verifies immediate expiry. Peer-approved and merged to main as dc70529 on 2026-11-24 after all nine checks passed, including Windows, macOS and Linux Rust tests and Clippy. Installed verification awaits the coordinated desktop update.
